candidates.snippet: 1895: Early experiments with radio waves - Began experimenting with wireless telegraphy at his family estate, demonstrating early success with radio wave transmission. 1901: First transatlantic radio transmission - Successfully transmitted radio signals across the Atlantic Ocean, a landmark achievement in wireless communication. 1909: Nobel Prize in Physics - Awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics for his contributions to the development of wireless telegraphy. 1919: Establishment of Radio Corporation of America (RCA) - Played a key role in the formation of RCA, consolidating radio interests in the United States.
